new_issues.summary: Side-effect of the R1 paginate=0 fix: requesting the sales-report PDF with NO date filter (the default sales-report view state) forces a full fetch of all ~2850 orders and dompdf renders every row -> HTTP 500 (fatal memory/time exhaustion, NOT the controller's caught 422 -> it is an uncaught PHP Error, not Exception). Reproduced: GET /api/admin/sales-report/pdf (no params) => 500 'Server Error'. Filtered ranges work (today=5224B, week=24566B, both 200 PDF). Realistic trigger: owner opens Rapport des Ventes (no dates set) and clicks Exporter -> PDF. Before the fix this never 500'd (always 10-row cap). Recommend: cap/stream or require a date range for PDF, or raise memory + set_time_limit.
new_issues.evidence: GET :8766/api/admin/sales-report/pdf => 500 (console error reproduced); filtered variants => 200. Controller app/Http/Controllers/Admin/SalesReportController.php:69 merges paginate=0; catch(Exception) does not catch fatal Error so 500 bypasses the 422 handler.

new_issues.summary: R1 fix #7 (baseURL) changed the sync origin from :8000 to :8766 as intended, but the request STILL returns 401 in this split-host dev env because the KDS sync call is not carrying the Sanctum auth header (other :8766 axios calls that DO carry the Bearer token succeed 200). Board INITIAL load renders fine (3 cards); the advertised 'rafraichissement automatique toutes les 60 s' is still non-functional as-audited. Fix #7 was documented 'no-op prod' (same-origin cookie auth) — that claim needs same-origin prod verification; the 401 is not resolved in dev.
